# A/B reference text

`ref-text-i-samuel-20-18-42.json` is the MAM Hebrew reference for the offline ASR
comparison, with cantillation/vowel marks removed. It contains no recording.
MAM attribution, the CC BY-SA 4.0 license and modification notice are in
[`tests/fixtures/trope/NOTICE.md`](../../../tests/fixtures/trope/NOTICE.md).
